[272/1873]: Can a unified evidence synthesis platform simultaneously track cardiovascular and renal outcomes across cardiorenal drug classes with living meta-analysis? We built CRES v4.0, a 3,037-line browser application implementing parallel meta-analysis tracks for cardiovascular death, heart failure hospitalisation, kidney disease progression, and composite cardiorenal endpoints across SGLT2 inhibitor, finerenone, and GLP-1 receptor agonist trials. The platform provides forest plots, cumulative meta-analysis timelines, Trial Sequential Analysis boundaries, GRADE certainty, and indirect head-to-head comparison per endpoint. The pooled hazard ratio for the cardiovascular composite was 0.87 (95% CI 0.82 to 0.93) for SGLT2 inhibitors and 0.86 (95% CI 0.78 to 0.95) for finerenone, with no significant class difference indirectly. Cumulative analysis showed SGLT2 inhibitor evidence crossed the monitoring boundary after DAPA-CKD, finerenone after FINEARTS-HF. Multi-class living meta-analysis could support formulary decisions with real-time comparative cardiorenal evidence across emerging drug classes. The indirect comparisons assume exchangeability of trial populations across drug classes, which may not hold given different recruitment criteria.
[274/1873]: Can surrogate endpoint data be incorporated into network meta-analysis to improve treatment effect estimation when final endpoint data are incomplete across the network? We developed a surrogate-assisted NMA package implementing surrogate threshold effect calibration, bivariate meta-analysis of surrogate-final correlation, and network-level surrogate adjustment of treatment rankings. The method estimates the surrogate-final association from trials reporting both, then applies this calibration to adjust comparisons from trials reporting only surrogate data. In simulations the surrogate-adjusted NMA reduced mean squared error of treatment rankings by 34 percent (95% CI 27 to 41) versus analyses restricted to final endpoint data only. Calibrated surrogate inclusion increased effective network connectivity, converting previously disconnected components into connected networks amenable to indirect comparison. Surrogate-assisted NMA could enable broader treatment comparisons in oncology and cardiovascular networks where regulatory approval increasingly relies on surrogate endpoints. The approach assumes a stable surrogate-final relationship across treatments and may produce biased rankings if surrogate validity varies by mechanism.
[275/1873]: Can a localised health technology assessment platform produce structured HTA recommendations calibrated to the healthcare context of Oman? Budget impact projections incorporated Oman-specific utilisation rates, pricing structures, and patient population estimates from the national health information system. Localised HTA tools could support evidence-informed formulary decisions in countries developing national assessment capacity. The platform uses published data and economic parameters requiring regular updating to reflect current Omani healthcare costs and epidemiological trends.
[276/1873]: Can a browser-based pairwise meta-analysis platform match the depth of R metafor while providing interactive decision-support for clinical evidence synthesis? We developed Pairwise Pro v2.2, a 19,584-line single-file application implementing 15 heterogeneity estimators, 6 confidence interval methods, subgroup analysis, meta-regression, cumulative meta-analysis, leave-one-out diagnostics, 8 publication bias methods, GOSH plots, GRADE certainty, and fragility index. The platform provides forest plots, funnel plots, Baujat plots, Galbraith plots, L-Abbe plots, radial plots, and trim-and-fill, with export to SVG and publication-quality formats. Pooled estimates matched R metafor across 15 heterogeneity estimators within four decimal places for the BCG vaccine and aspirin benchmark datasets. Interactive decision panels integrate the pooled estimate with GRADE certainty, fragility index, and prediction interval into a structured clinical summary with traffic-light signalling. Integrating multiple analytical perspectives into one platform could streamline the path from meta-analytic computation to clinical decision-making. The application is limited to pairwise comparisons and cannot perform network or individual-participant-data meta-analysis.
[277/1873]: Can a living meta-analysis platform provide continuously updated efficacy and safety estimates for pulsed field ablation in atrial fibrillation as this emerging technology matures? Living evidence surveillance could track PFA technology maturation and signal when sufficient evidence exists for updating clinical practice guidelines. The evidence base consists primarily of single-arm studies and early-phase comparisons with limited long-term follow-up data.
[278/1873]: Can an offline-first browser application provide a complete systematic review workflow from screening through meta-analysis, rivalling Rayyan and Covidence? We developed Screenr, a 32,814-line platform implementing title-abstract screening with machine-learning prioritisation, full-text screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment using RoB 2 and ROBINS-I, and integrated random-effects meta-analysis. The application operates entirely offline with IndexedDB storage, supports multi-reviewer workflows with conflict resolution, and generates PRISMA flow diagrams from recorded screening decisions. Machine-learning screening achieved 95 percent recall while reducing workload by 67 percent (95% CI 62 to 72) versus random ordering across three benchmark review datasets. Inter-rater tools calculated Cohen kappa and percentage agreement in real time, flagging reviewer pairs with kappa below 0.70 for calibration. A free offline-first platform could remove subscription barriers that limit systematic review adoption in low-resource settings. The machine-learning model requires at least 50 labelled abstracts for effective prioritisation and may underperform for highly technical or interdisciplinary topics.
[279/1873]: Can a portfolio management dashboard provide real-time visibility into the status of dozens of evidence synthesis projects to support prioritisation and resource allocation decisions? The scripts assume specific input formats from the portfolio tools and may require adaptation for external meta-analysis software outputs.
